## About
We're a family owned auto repair shop on Hamilton Cleves Rd, and a NAPA Auto Care Center. Our technicians are certified by the National Institute for Automotive Service Excellence (ASE), and we carry a full selection of tires from leading brands at fair prices.
You'll probably talk to Dave at the service desk or Jake on the phone. One customer told us Dave keeps "great communication," and another said Jake was "super kind and professional from the first call." A reviewer with a car named Jessie thought he had a transmission problem. It turned out to be a bad coil, and that's all we fixed.
We keep the shop a place where you can bring your kids. Neighbors rate us 4.7 from 54 Google reviews, and we'd be glad to earn your business too.

## Services
- Preventive Maintenance: Regular upkeep to keep your car running mile after mile. One customer has trusted us with maintenance on both of his cars.
- Diagnostics & Check Engine Lights: We find out what's really causing the light before we replace anything.
- Steering & Suspension: Steering and suspension work for cars, trucks and SUVs.
- Engine & Transmission Repair: Engine and transmission repair for the car or truck you drive every day.
- Jasper Engines & Transmissions: JASPER remanufactured engines and transmissions, backed by a 3-year/100,000 mile nationwide warranty.
- Car, Truck & SUV Tires: A full selection of tires from leading brands at fair and competitive prices.
- Fleet Services: Service for commercial vehicles, including heavy-duty trucks, done as quickly as possible without cutting corners.
- Lift Kits: More ground clearance and room for bigger tires and wheels on your truck or SUV.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday - Friday: 8:00am - 5:00pm. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're in Hamilton on Hamilton Cleves Rd, and we serve Hamilton, Fairfield, Ross and the surrounding communities.

Q: Do you work on heavy-duty trucks?
A: Yes. Our technicians specialize in commercial vehicles and service heavy-duty trucks and fleets of all kinds.

Q: I manage a fleet account. Can you help?
A: Give us a call and we'll talk through what your drivers and vehicles need.
